blocker: persist_generic_associations must participate in exactly the same short transaction as assessment, lineage, bindings, and current update. Existing publish_with_lineage owns and commits its transaction, so composing the current functions would permit partial association persistence if subsequent publication fails.
required_remediation: Refactor the existing publisher into a transaction-scoped primitive (no nested begin/commit) and one canonical wrapper that performs assessment, candidate-owned associations, lineage, bindings, freshness decision, and commit atomically; qualify failure rollback before runtime wiring.
